card.title: Truth or Loyalty
card.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 truth is opposed to a brother's promise; A3 seeks anonymous exoneration and A5 repeats loyalty as the cost of honesty.

relationship.evidence: B2 cares about an innocent cleaner and B4 explains why omission will not answer the question.

heightening.evidence: B4 eliminates indirect protection; A5 sharpens emotional pressure, though it largely restates A1's choice.

specificity.evidence: A1 mother's vase, little brother and promise plus B2 cleaner establish specific family accountability.
